result.title: XForecast: The KDD 2026 Finance Day Challenge on News-Grounded Financial Forecasting
result.summary: Financial forecasting has traditionally relied on numerical time-series (TS) signals, while textual information such as news remains largely underutilized. We introduce XForecast, a benchmark and competition for news-grounded financial forecasting, where the task is to predict stock price movements four weeks ahead using both historical price data and paired news signals. XForecast combines stock price data with curated financial text generated using FinTexTS, a multimodal dataset generation method. It covers 100 large-cap stocks from 2019--2023, with training on 2019--2022 and evaluation on 2023. To better evaluate models that leverage textual signals, we adopt a weighted hit rate metric that places greater emphasis on instances where news information is expected to have stronger influence. The XForecast Challenge, hosted on Kaggle as part of KDD 2026 Finance Day, aims to benchmark methods for integrating financial TS and textual information.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 XForecast 基准与 KDD 2026 金融日竞赛：用历史股价与配套新闻文本预测四周后的股票走势，覆盖 2019–2023 年 100 只大盘股，并采用对新闻影响较大样本加权的命中率指标来评估文本信号的利用。
AI.relevance_reason: 价格与文本的融合并非视觉推理，主线联系很弱；但其「按模态预期影响力加权」的评价设计，可能可供核查如何条件化评估视觉证据在 LVR 中真正起作用的样本。
